---
title: "Carolina HighGround"
subtitle: "Storm Impacts, Terrain, Infrastructure, and Community Resilience in Western North Carolina"
author:
  - Kent Lee
  - Matthew Martin
  - Aaron Chen
  - Minh Nguyen
date: today
title-block-banner: "#12344d"
title-block-banner-color: "#ffffff"

format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-location: left
    toc-depth: 3
    toc-title: "Contents"
    number-sections: true
    number-depth: 2
    code-fold: true
    code-summary: "Show code"
    code-tools:
      source: false
      toggle: true
      caption: "Code"
    embed-resources: true
    theme: cosmo
    css: styles.css
    highlight-style: kate
    lightbox: true
    fig-align: center
    page-layout: article
    grid:
      body-width: 1000px
      sidebar-width: 260px

execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
  freeze: false

params:
  # All paths are relative to project_dir (this file lives in src/).
  project_dir: ".."
  figures_dir: "outs/figures"
  tables_dir: "outs/tables"
  ml_dir: "data/ml_ready"
  derived_dir: "data/derived"

  # Raw inputs (read-only)
  noaa_dir: "data/raw/noaa"
  nhd_zip_path: "data/raw/nhd/NHD_H_North_Carolina_State_Shape.zip"
  nhd_dir: "data/raw/nhd/extracted"
  ncdot_culverts_path: "data/raw/ncdot/ncdot_culverts_nc.gpkg"
  ncdot_structures_path: "data/raw/ncdot/ncdot_structures_nc.gpkg"
  dem_path: "data/raw/dem_3dep/3dep_dem_north_carolina_epsg32119.tif"
  slope_path: "data/raw/dem_3dep/slope_degrees_epsg32119.tif"
  roughness_path: "data/raw/dem_3dep/roughness_epsg32119.tif"
  nlcd_path: "data/raw/nlcd/annual_nlcd_fractional_impervious_2023_NC.tif"
  nlcd_vintage: "2023"
  soils_dir: "data/raw/usda_soils"
  soil_spatial_path: null
  state_boundary_path: "data/raw/nlcd/north_carolina_boundary.gpkg"
  county_boundaries_path: "data/raw/reference/nc_counties.gpkg"
  rainfall_path: null
  community_path: null

  # Data processing
  download_data: false
  refresh_derived_data: false
  use_cached_features: true

  # Study area
  state_name: "NORTH CAROLINA"
  study_area: "Western North Carolina"
  study_counties:
    - "Buncombe"
    - "Henderson"
    - "Haywood"
    - "Madison"
    - "McDowell"
    - "Transylvania"
    - "Yancey"
    - "Avery"
    - "Watauga"
    - "Jackson"
    - "Swain"

  # Signature event highlighted in the story (Hurricane/Tropical Storm Helene)
  highlight_event_name: "Helene"
  highlight_start_date: "2024-09-24"
  highlight_end_date: "2024-09-30"

  # Years
  start_year: 2016
  end_year: 2026
  partial_years:
    - 2026

  # Coordinate systems
  analysis_crs: 32119
  geographic_crs: 4326
  # Event coordinates outside this lon/lat box are treated as unusable
  coord_lon_min: -84.5
  coord_lon_max: -75.3
  coord_lat_min: 33.7
  coord_lat_max: 36.7

  # Event filters
  flood_event_pattern: "flood|heavy rain|debris flow|landslide"
  tropical_event_pattern: "hurricane|tropical storm|tropical depression"
  feature_event_scope: "all"

  # Region assignment
  zone_descriptor_words:
    - "WESTERN"
    - "EASTERN"
    - "NORTHERN"
    - "SOUTHERN"
    - "CENTRAL"
    - "INLAND"
    - "COASTAL"
    - "EAST"
    - "WEST"
    - "NORTH"
    - "SOUTH"
    - "GREATER"
    - "MOUNTAINS"
  special_coastal_zone_pattern: "OUTER BANKS|OCRACOKE ISLAND|HATTERAS ISLAND"

  # Buffer distances in meters
  event_buffer_m: 250
  infrastructure_buffer_m: 1000
  stream_buffer_m: 250

  # NHD flowline types (FType): 460 StreamRiver, 558 ArtificialPath
  nhd_flowline_ftypes:
    - 460
    - 558
  compute_stream_density: true

  # Target configuration
  target_name: "high_consequence"
  damage_quantile: 0.90
  target_positive_damage_only: true
  death_target_value: 1
  target_threshold_basis: "train_split"   # leakage-safe: threshold from training years only
  damage_missing_as_zero: true

  # Chronological split
  train_end_year: 2021
  validation_end_year: 2023

  # Spatial feature controls
  include_nhd_features: true
  include_wbd_features: true
  include_dem_features: true
  include_nlcd_features: true
  include_ncdot_features: true
  include_soil_features: false
  include_rainfall_features: false
  include_community_features: false

  # Visualization controls
  top_n_event_types: 15
  top_n_events_table: 10
  create_interactive_maps: true
  create_static_maps: true
  figure_dpi: 200

  # Interview controls
  include_interview: true
  interview_path: "data/raw/media/Interview.mp4"
  interview_web_path: "data/derived/media/interview_web.mp4"
  interview_poster_path: "data/derived/media/interview_poster.jpg"
  interview_embed_video: true
  interview_transcript_path: "data/derived/media/interview_audio.json"
  interview_highlights_path: "src/content/interview_highlights.csv"
  interview_consent_confirmed: true
  interview_is_anonymous: false
  interview_display_name: "two friends who attended Asheville High School during Hurricane Helene"
  show_interview_quotes: true
  # Names spoken in the recording that are replaced with [name] in the written transcript
  interview_redact_names:
    - "Noah Goldblatt"
    - "Everett"

  modeling_section: false

  # Subsetting (off for the full run; see analysis_quick.qmd)
  subset_enabled: false
  subset_study_area_only: false
  subset_flood_only: false
  subset_max_events: null
  subset_seed: 2026

  # Export controls
  export_csv: true
  export_parquet: true
  export_spatial_layer: true
  export_feature_dictionary: true
  allow_degraded_export: false
---

{{< include _analysis_body.qmd >}}

{{< include _model_placeholder.qmd >}}

{{< include _appendix.qmd >}}
